_comment: Curated body-size ranges (mm, body length, or diameter for spherical colonies), keyed by OTT id. Used in preference to PBDB-derived sizes. The note says which life stages and sexes the range covers. check: 'full_text' = the range, units and citation were checked against the full text of the cited work; 'abstract' = only the abstract could be read. Choanoflagellida has no curated size: the cited review gives none, and no open source was verified (removed in v0.1).

111438.note: Whole phylum: 50-2100 µm long, usually 250-500 µm (review statement).

7485612.note: Body length from hatchling (~125 µm) to fully grown adult (~240 µm); animals start laying eggs well before full size.

395048.note: Adult, ~1 mm long (newly hatched larvae 0.25 mm).

270732.note: Eriophyoid mites, body length 101-306 µm (approximately 0.1-0.3 mm).

3320116.note: Adult males only, ~139-240 µm, the smallest adult insects known. Males are ~0.4 times the body length of females, so females are larger than this range.

391120.note: Vegetative spheroid (colony) diameter, up to 500 µm.
